name: RPG Stash
statusMeaning: Its content is data; Kiln 0.2.0 generates its structures in Horizon's worlds. Not tried in the game.
author: maevius
description: Adds an RPG-styled stash (ender chest) to every village, allowing you to safely and conveniently access your valuables on your adventures!
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Data only, with 19 structure files: Kiln 0.2.0 generates structures from data in Horizon's worlds. Not tried in the game.
